北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 气温 4℃ 体感 -3℃，风力 4级，多云有风，注意保暖别感冒哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: It feels like -3℃ with strong winds. Stay warm and don't catch a cold!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗 8℃，体感 5℃，微风舒适。出门记得防晒，享受阳光！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and 8℃, a comfortable 5℃. Enjoy the sunshine, remember sun protection!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 多云 8℃，体感 5℃。风儿有些凉，别忘了添衣哦，照顾好自己！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 8℃, feels like 5℃. A bit chilly, remember to add a layer and take care!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗 14℃，体感 12℃，微风宜人。出门晒晒太阳，心情会更好！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and 14℃, feels like 12℃. Enjoy the pleasant breeze and sunshine!
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 多云 15℃，体感 12℃。早晚温差大，记得及时添衣哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 15℃, feels like 12℃. Mind the temperature change between morning and evening!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗 9℃，体感 6℃。注意保暖，别让凉风吹感冒哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and 9℃, feels like 6℃. Stay warm, don't let the cool breeze catch you!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗 10℃，体感 7℃。虽然阳光好，但温度仍低，注意保暖！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny 10℃, feels like 7℃. Although sunny, temperatures are still low, stay warm!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗 11℃，体感 9℃。气温适中，微风轻拂，出门散步好时节！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and 11℃, feels like 9℃. Perfect weather for a stroll with a gentle breeze!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗 10℃，体感 8℃。湿度稍高，体感舒适，记得多喝水哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Sunny 10℃, feels like 8℃. Humidity is a bit high, stay hydrated!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗 8℃，体感 6℃。天气干燥，请多补充水分，保护好皮肤！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Sunny 8℃, feels like 6℃. It's dry, please hydrate well and protect your skin!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 多云 12℃，体感 11℃。气温舒适，但早晚仍凉，记得穿衣！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 12℃, feels like 11℃. Comfortable temperatures, but evenings are still cool, remember to dress warmly!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天 -16℃，体感 -21℃！北风 3级，超级冷，一定要全副武装！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Overcast -16℃, feels like -21℃! It's extremely cold with a level 3 north wind, bundle up!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -21℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天 0℃，体感 -2℃。请务必穿暖和，别让寒气入体哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Overcast 0℃, feels like -2℃. Please dress warmly to keep the cold out!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗 13℃，体感 11℃。阳光正好，微风舒适，享受美好时光！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and 13℃, feels like 11℃. Perfect sunshine and comfortable breeze, enjoy your day!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗 11℃，体感 6℃，东风 4级。风力较大，出门小心着凉！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Sunny 11℃, feels like 6℃ with a strong easterly wind. Be careful not to catch a cold!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗 8℃，体感 3℃，风力 4级。风大体感更冷，多穿点哦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Sunny 8℃, feels like 3℃ with strong winds. It feels colder with the wind, dress warmly!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天 4℃，体感 1℃。天气微凉，多穿衣物，小心感冒！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Overcast 4℃, feels like 1℃. It's cool, wear more layers and watch out for colds!
